text:
sam_csm: Posting a tiny 'SqueezePlay' runbook we tried with a midmarket trial last week. It's deliberately compact for 5-10 minute preflight calls.

ivy_onboard: Nice name. Can you paste the 7-point micro-check we actually read out loud? Want it on the customer-facing checklist.

sam_csm: Yep 
1) Warmpool target = 6 for first 90m.
2) Prefill top-25 prefixes into prefix cache.
3) Prefill heavy users (top 5) long-tail responses.
4) Client must send X-Client-Queue + X-Session-Hint.
5) Set stream_fallback_ms = 750 (p50 first-token).
6) Wire feedback webhook for 24h + 7d pings.
7) Enable short-term reserved capacity if cold-start errors >3 in 30m.

mira_eng: Quick client header snippet for customers:
```
POST /v1/chat/stream
Headers:
  X-Client-Queue: tenant-<ID>-<rand>
  X-Session-Hint: web-<sid>
  X-Idempotency-Key: <uuid>
  Accept: text/event-stream
```

raj_sre: Ops heuristics we used in the pilot: warmpool_miss_rate >5% over 10m -> page oncall; stream_partial_rate >3% -> mark sessions non-streaming; prefills_eviction_rate >40/min -> alert eng. Also: if p95 first-token increases by >200ms vs baseline, schedule 1h remediation call.

ivy_onboard: Renewal-risk quick rule we used: usage drop >=30% + two of (p95 latency up >=150ms, negative feedback at 24h, repeated warm_pool misses) -> AM outreach + "stabilize" playbook.

sam_csm: Tiny emulator we hand to customers for prelaunch (single-line):
`seq 1 200 | xargs -n1 -P10 curl -s -H "X-Client-Queue: tenant-$T" -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -d '{"prompt":"smoke"}' https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate &>/dev/null`

ivy_onboard: Feedback payload we push at 24h and 7d: `\{"q\":\"Rate usefulness 1-5\",\"meta\":{\"p95\":\"${p95}\",\"tokens\":\"${tokens}\"}}`. Low score -> auto-create playbook task.

safety-bot: Playbook created: https://board.redwood.internal/play/33721 tags=[squeezeplay, warmpool, feedback] :white_check_mark:

sam_csm: I'll add owners and a Day-2 15m check reminder. Short & sweet for customer calls. Thanks!
